verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs mention 'incoming webhooks' for integrations and an API/bot framework that lets bots 'react to messages' in real time, which functions similarly to event subscription, but no evidence describes an outgoing webhook mechanism for external AI agents to subscribe to Zulip events. missing for 10: explicit outgoing-webhook/event-subscription API docs, event schema, and third-party confirmation that AI agents can hook into Zulip events this way.
